description: This file implements logging and log retrieval functionalities for the Mattermost platform, including logger configuration, log file access, log filtering, and advanced log handling.

classes.name: PlatformService
classes.description: Service struct providing logging and log management functionalities within the Mattermost platform.

methods.name: Log
methods.description: Returns the logger interface associated with the platform service.

methods.name: ReconfigureLogger
methods.description: Reinitializes and reconfigures the logging system.

methods.name: initLogging
methods.description: Initializes and configures the logging system, including creating loggers and setting targets.

methods.name: RemoveUnlicensedLogTargets
methods.description: Removes log targets if the license does not support advanced logging features.

methods.name: GetLogsSkipSend
methods.description: Retrieves log lines from the log file with filtering and pagination.

methods.name: GetLogFile
methods.description: Retrieves the entire log file content as a downloadable file.

methods.name: validateLogFilePath
methods.description: Validates that a log file path is within the allowed logging directory to prevent security issues.

methods.name: GetAdvancedLogs
methods.description: Retrieves additional log files based on advanced logging configuration.

methods.name: isLogFilteredByLevel
methods.description: Checks if a log entry should be filtered out based on log level.

methods.name: isLogFilteredByDate
methods.description: Checks if a log entry should be filtered out based on date range.
